The 7SABER Memory Foam Insoles feature Viscotechnology designed to alleviate excessive foot pressure during walking. They provide excellent support and cushioning, adapting to the shape of your foot. The insoles include specially designed airholes for breathability, shock absorption, and odor reduction, effectively cushioning the heels, knees, and ankles. They are suitable for handwashing with soap. The price is $5.50, and they are available in Black, Grey, Blue, and Red colors, with sizes ranging from 36/37 to 44/45. You can view them [here](https://7saber.uz/storage/product/11505WiWdYAROVPns5ET0.jpg).
